title: No test opens the History tab's loading, failed, empty or not-sent states
what: The only History check is one line on a computer that a done task says 'Done · 1 credit'. Nothing checks the 'could not load' line, the 'Nothing yet' line, rows that say Not sent, Cancelled or Did not work with no credits, or that tapping a row puts the words back in the box without asking.
expected: A test drives History offline, empty, and with each kind of task, and taps a row.
fix_line: Add one screen test for the History tab covering failed, empty, each status and a row tap.

title: The voice sheet's problem lines and Cancel are never seen by a test
what: Tests only check that a browser error is turned into a short code. No test shows the blocked, no-microphone, too-short or nothing-heard sentences, the Close button, Cancel stopping the microphone, the 30 second stop, or that the owner can fix the words before sending.
expected: A screen test fakes each microphone problem and Cancel, and edits the heard words before sending.
fix_line: Add a voice screen test for each problem line, Cancel, the time limit and editing the words.

title: No test taps an idea's action button or the credits pill on Today
what: Tests check the ideas fit the phone and that See who lists the right members, but none taps the action button that should open the assistant with the idea asked once and a draft to check, and none taps the credits pill. The known bug where an idea is dropped when questions are used up has no test either.
expected: A test taps an idea's button (normal and with today's questions used up) and the pill, and checks what opens.
fix_line: Add a Today test that taps an idea's button and the pill and checks the assistant opens with one ask.

title: The examples sheet and the Try saying sentences are opened but never used in a test
what: The test opens 'What the AI Assistant can do' and closes it. Nothing checks its groups, that the number in the link equals the sentences, or that tapping a sentence closes the sheet and puts it in the box without asking.
expected: A test taps an example, checks it lands in the box unsent, and counts the sheet's sentences against the link.
fix_line: Extend the assistant screen test to tap an example and count the sheet.

title: No test shows the ask box locked when today's free questions are used up
what: Tests only check that the locked words have a Hindi version and that the limit code counts as locked. Nothing checks on screen that the box is greyed out, send stays off, and a tapped example does not get asked.
expected: A screen test with the day limit reached checks the locked box, the off send button and that nothing is asked.
how_often: once a day for busy gyms
fix_line: Add a screen test with the day limit reached.

title: A question-back card's choices and typed answer are never tested
what: The test only reads the question text. Nothing checks the choice buttons, at most six of them, that tapping one asks it once, the 'Type your answer in the box below.' line when there are no choices, or that the answer keeps the question in mind.
expected: A test taps a choice and answers a no-choice question, checking one new bubble and the next card.
fix_line: Add choice-tap and typed-answer steps to the assistant screen test.

title: No assistant test taps twice or clears the chat
what: No test double-taps send, a choice, Send to AI Assistant or Save changes to prove one tap makes one request or one save, and no test clears the chat to check the examples come back and saved tasks stay.
expected: Tests double-tap each sending button and clear the chat once.
fix_line: Add double-tap and clear-chat steps to the assistant tests.
